svg.aria-label: How I work — 7 engineering principles: Simple before clever, Explicit before implicit, Tested before validated, Automated before manual, Maintainable before trend, Business value before technical ego, AI accelerates, but does not replace discipline.
svg.title: How I work
svg.desc: Engineering principles that guide how the work is done.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: HOW I WORK

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Simple before clever
The cleverest code is a debt for the person who reads it. I
choose the simplest solution that really solves the problem.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Explicit before implicit
Hidden behavior is expensive to debug. I make intentions,
contracts and dependencies visible.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Tested before validated
Code without tests isn't finished, it's just written. Tests
describe behavior and outlive refactors.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Automated before manual
Anything manual ends up being forgotten or botched. Lint,
build, release, quality: quality gates, not good will.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Maintainable before trend
A technology is chosen for what it will cost to maintain in
two years' time, not for its current buzz.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Business value before technical ego
Understand the business problem before writing any lines.
The best architecture is the one that serves the objective,
not the demonstration.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: AI accelerates, but does not replace discipline
I use AI as an engineering gas pedal, not as a substitute.
Without clear specs, solid architecture, testing and
mastered context, AI just generates chaos faster.
